mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE crosses above 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when GDPC1 declines by >2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals robust labor market expansion, boosting earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 97 signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO falls below 97 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) above 5% of GDP signals elevated precautionary savings, reducing consumer spending and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS exceeds 5% of GDP (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in new single-family home sales (HOUST) above 700,000 signals a housing market recovery, boosting construction-related earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when HOUST exceeds 700,000 (t-test p > 0.05).
